result.title: Cross-Modal StateKV Injection for Communication in Multi-LLM Systems across Temporal Segments
result.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Equal contribution: Xiaoqian Zhang and Zhihao Zhang
result.summary: Video understanding with multiple multimodal language models requires a communication interface that can transfer complementary visual observations. Text-based communication is interpretable, but introduces an intermediate generation stage and can omit information relevant to subsequent reasoning. We study Cross-Modal StateKV Injection, a provider--carrier framework that communicates through key--value (KV) states at visual-token positions. Provider models observe complementary video frames; their visual KV states are aligned and projected into the carrier representation space and integrated through gated residual updates. Injection preserves the carrier KV-cache sequence length, while retaining the additional computation required by the providers and the communication module. The reported experiments on MLVU and Video-MME compare carrier-only inference, text-based communication, and StateKV with two provider architectures. Results show modest, task-dependent accuracy gains and lower reported latency than the evaluated text-communication baseline, with some categories remaining unchanged or decreasing. Increasing provider-side frame coverage offers additional gains on selected tasks without extending the carrier cache. These findings motivate further study of visual KV communication under explicitly controlled observation and computation budgets.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Cross-Modal StateKV Injection：观察互补视频帧的 provider 模型将视觉 token 位置的 KV 状态对齐投影到 carrier 表示空间并门控残差注入，使多 LLM 系统以 latent KV 而非文本传递视觉观察；在 MLVU 和 Video-MME 上比较其与纯 carrier、文本通信的准确率和延迟。
